name: Pinochle Scoreboard
subtitle: Bids, meld, tricks, and scores
promotionalText: One more hand. Keep your pinochle table organized with saved games, quick round entry, and an offline scoring guide.
description:
Keep the focus on the cards and the company. Pinochle Scoreboard brings your table a warm card-room scorebook for bids, meld, tricks, and final scores.

KEEP EVERY TABLE GOING
Start multiple games and return to any ongoing game when you are ready. Your games and scores stay on your device.

SCORE EACH HAND
Record the bid, enter each team's meld and trick points, and let the scoreboard calculate the round. It handles missed bids, the requirement to win a trick to count meld, and moon shots.

KEEP A LEDGER
Review completed games and their rounds. End a game early to save its scores, or delete games you no longer need.

SCORING HELP AT HAND
Open the scoring guide for meld values, trick points, and the scoreboard's rules. Everything you need for scoring works offline.

Made for two-team pinochle with a 1,500-point target. The scoring guide explains the included house rules.

No account, advertising, or analytics. One more hand.
reviewNotes: No sign-in is required. Start a new game, enter two team names, and choose Add a round. Record the bid winner, meld, and trick points. The Scoring guide explains the app's house rules. About and privacy is linked at the bottom of the main table. This is an offline scorekeeping utility; it does not offer wagering, cash prizes, in-app purchases, user accounts, chat, ads, or analytics.
appPrivacyDraft: Data Not Collected — based on the current release source. Support email is optional and handled outside the app.
